data.summary: Customer reports being charged twice for their monthly plan ($19.99 each time) yesterday.

replies.formal: Hello. A second charge usually has one of three causes: a temporary authorization hold that disappears within 3–5 business days; two separate purchases (for example a subscription and a credit pack); or a genuine duplicate charge. To help us investigate this for you, please provide the date, amount, and the last 4 digits of your card, or send a screenshot of your bank statement. Nebula Support Team
replies.empathetic: It is understandably stressful to notice unexpected duplicate charges on your account. Please share the date, amount, and the last 4 digits of your card, or a screenshot of your bank statement so we can check this for you. Nebula Support Team
